content.short: World Challenge Game blends a mobile app with blockchain in its board game.
content.description: World Challenge Game blends a traditional board game with a companion mobile app and blockchain integration, offering strategy and knowledge content in English and Spanish. Each session features a unique QR code for NFT redemption, enhancing the mobile experience while preserving the core board game feel. World Challenge Game is an EUIPO-registered trademark. Players worldwide can connect and earn rewards through NFTs. The ecosystem uses the WORLD token for transactions, with earnings reinvested toward token burning and additional rewards for players.
